description: This file contains the implementation of the LiveSignalPub interface, providing functionality to publish commands, events, and signals in a distributed pub/sub system within an actor-based architecture.

classes.name: LiveSignalPubImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for LiveSignalPub, managing distributed pubs for commands, events, and signals based on actor context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to initialize the LiveSignalPubImpl with actor context, creating distributed pubs for commands, events, and signals.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Returns the distributed pub for command messages.

methods.name: event
methods.description: Returns the distributed pub for event messages.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Returns the distributed pub for signals (messages).

methods.name: getTopicExtractor
methods.description: Private helper to create a pub/sub topic extractor based on streaming type.
